bio: Diners are spoilt for choice here! The variety of delicious dishes on offer ranges from wonderful starters such as vitello tonnato and delicious soups to risotto and Thai curry and Austrian classics such as Tafelspitz (beef boiled in broth), Wiener schnitzel or local char – all prepared using good, fresh produce. For dessert, the poppy seed noodles, for example, are extremely tempting. The atmosphere in this lively restaurant in the centre of the village is also inviting with its cosy, modern decor. Friendly service, and in summer be sure to make the most of the lovely terrace in front of the building....
